Recent changes

March 1, 2026

Bot API 9.5

  • Added the field iconCustomEmojiId to the class BottomButton.

December 29, 2023

Bot API 7.0

  • Added the field SettingsButton to the class WebApp.
  • Mini Apps no longer close when the method WebApp.openTelegramLink is called.

June 20, 2022

Bot API 6.1

  • Added the fields version, BackButton and the method isVersionAtLeast to the class WebApp.
  • Added the method offClick to the class MainButton.
  • Added the events backButtonClicked.

Designing Mini Apps

Initializing Mini Apps

FieldTypeDescription
initDataStringA string with raw data.
versionStringThe version of the Bot API available in the user's Telegram app.
isActiveBooleanBot API 8.0+ True, if active.
MainButtonBottomButtonAn object for the main button.
BackButtonBackButtonAn object for the back button.
SettingsButtonSettingsButtonAn object for the settings item.
Serverless NEWServerlessAn object for endpoints.
close()FunctionA method that closes the Mini App.
isVersionAtLeast(version)FunctionReturns true if the user's app supports a version.
openLink(url[, options])FunctionOpens a link. Bot API 6.4+ options.
